description: Use this when the user wants bpm to ms, a delay time calculator, tempo calculator, note cycle hertz, milliseconds to beats per minute, bar length or song length. Accepts BPM or a note duration and returns whole to sixty-fourth values, dotted and triplet, pre-delay suggestions and approximate Italian marking ranges. BPM is quarter notes per minute, 20 to 400; up to 100000 song bars. Hertz is rhythmic repetition, not pitch. Does not record audio or detect pitch.

bars.description: Optional song bar count at this tempo and time signature. Example: 32.

beat_unit.description: Time signature denominator. Default 4. BPM remains quarter-note BPM. Example: 8 for 6/8.

beats_per_bar.description: Time signature numerator, 1 to 16. Default 4. Example: 6 for 6/8.

bpm.description: Quarter notes per minute, 20 to 400, up to three decimal places. Example: 120.

milliseconds.description: Duration of the selected note, instead of bpm; resulting BPM must be 20 to 400. Up to three decimal places. Example: 500.

modifier.description: Modifier for milliseconds: straight (default), dotted, or triplet. Example: dotted.

note_value.description: Note represented by milliseconds; default quarter. Only use with milliseconds. Example: eighth.

name: calculate_tempo_values
title: Calculate tempo values
